title: HSK1 Gate 10 · Eastern Jin
explanationEn: Gate 10: Eastern Jin. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第10关：东晋。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 晋朝有一位诗人，叫陶渊明。他年轻的时候做过官。做官有钱，也有名。可是他不喜欢，因为做官的人每天都要说不想说的话。
passageEn: In the Jin dynasty there was a poet called Tao Yuanming. When he was young, he was an official. An official has money, and a name. But he did not like it, because an official has to say things every day that he does not want to say.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the Jin dynasty there was a poet called Tao Yuanming.
comprehension.answer: 晋朝有一位诗人，叫陶渊明。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: An official has money, and a name.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 一 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“一”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 一 (yī) means "one" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “一”（yī）的意思是“one”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 叫 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“叫”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 叫 (jiào) means "called" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “叫”（jiào）的意思是“called”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 晋朝有一位诗人，叫陶渊明。

options.text: In the Jin dynasty there was a poet called Tao Yuanming.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.

check.explanationEn: "晋朝有一位诗人，叫陶渊明。" means "In the Jin dynasty there was a poet called Tao Yuanming.".
check.explanation: “晋朝有一位诗人，叫陶渊明。”的意思是“In the Jin dynasty there was a poet called Tao Yuanming.”。
